newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish T-bill secondary trade up 51.6 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Polish T-bill secondary trade up 51.6 pct in Oct.

text.p: Secondary turnover in Polish T-bills rose to 47.26 billion zlotys in October from 31.18 billion in September, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said that October secondary trade in NBP-bills rose 60.7 percent to 7.36 billion zlotys from 4.58 billion in September.
Average T-bill holdings in domestic non-financial client portfolios rose 16.5 percent to 8.37 billion zlotys in October from September's 7.18 billion, the NBP said.
